locator: The classified business list, 'Automobile Livery and Garage': 'WEST MOTOR LIVERY CO. 2127-2129 Indiana av. tels. Calumet-405 and 406'; and a display advertisement, 'West Motor Livery Co., High Grade Auto Service, First Class Garage ... 2127-2129 Indiana Ave. Call Calumet 405'. For 216 E. 20th (T-3154): 'Kavanagh Marcus Judge, 216 E. 2oth', 'Kellar Murray P. 216 E. 20th.' and 'Willing E. A. Miss, 216 E 2oth'.

note: By 1911 the 2127-2129 half of the livery was a motor livery and garage under the West name, on the 405 and 406 lines the West horse livery used in 1910: the GARAGE the 1911 sheet draws on 2129-2131 is the address the livery had held since Bane Brothers' day.
what_it_supplies: that the 1911 garage at 2127-2129 Indiana Avenue was the West livery's motor branch
what_it_does_not_supply: the building's form, storeys, material or outline
